According to the course material, how many types of motivation in health education are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two main types of motivation in health education: Intrinsic Motivation: This comes from within the individual, such as a personal desire to improve health, curiosity about health topics, or the satisfaction of achieving a healthier lifestyle.
